purpose: Work file: 'Schermen 1.0', panels like btop: the proposal, beta for Cijferen, architecture helpers, rollout choices and the phases.
details: Status: ready for action (22/11/2026). The father (21/11) wanted better use of the screen: the buddy column, long questions, unclear tips, the klad position. Contains the choices, the 80×24 layout proposal (fixed panels: Vraag, Klad, Tip left; buddy right), the beta for Cijferen behind LEERAVONTUUR_BETA=1, supporting components (terminal/vak.py, terminal/indeling.py), the decision that the rollout is per child with a parent switch (23/11), choices after the inventory and the phases (each a branch with a PR and version from 0.27.0, proof at 80×24, 120×40 and 240×67).
summary: Plan for the new panel-based screens: why (screen space is badly used), choices, the 80×24 layout, the Cijferen beta, building blocks (vak.py), rollout per child with a parent switch, one method for all exercises (Vraag, Klad with Tab, Tip with F1, cheat sheet), and the phase list with evidence rules.
